identity.one_of_one_hook: Walking mausoleum with Grave Maul, tombstone barricades, defense-eroding decay and temporary Endurance armor.
identity.silhouette_read: Broad spiked gothic mausoleum armor, horned visor, purple lantern chains, long-handled mausoleum hammer and tattered funeral cloth.
identity.gameplay_promise: Pressure high-durability targets, control space with tomb barriers, weaken enemies in corrupted ground and survive extended fights.
identity.counterplay: Exact cooldowns, resource limits, barrier duration, target criteria and counterplay require separate gameplay design and testing.

design.visual_identity: Massive graveborn humanoid juggernaut, walking mausoleum silhouette, broad shoulders, heavy armored limbs, wide stance. Closed angular horned helmet with vertical purple glowing visor slits; retain exact face/helmet shapes in the four expression studies. Layered aged iron and mausoleum stone armor with bronze-gold edging, jagged spikes, bone carving and shoulder skull ornaments. Purple void-soul energy glows through rib-like chest armor and gothic window-like openings; preserve the pointed-arch illuminated structure on his back. Heavy chains, suspended purple soul lanterns, tattered purple funeral cloth and front tabard; no pirate rigging or generic cape substitution. Grave Maul is the signature long-handled gothic mausoleum-shaped hammer with spiked roof, glowing pointed-arch purple windows and hanging lanterns. Preserve the exact 4:3 AETHERFALL source sheet, front/side/back turnaround and materials/palette, not an earlier alternative or a generated approximation.
design.accessibility_notes: Check contrast, gameplay-distance silhouette, VFX obstruction, color-blind readability, sound alternatives and safe flashes in real tests.

active_abilities.name: Grave Maul
active_abilities.summary: A devastating, empowered maul strike that crushes enemies, dealing heavy damage (increased against high-durability targets).

active_abilities.name: Bone Bastion
active_abilities.summary: Raises jagged grave-spires or tombstone barricades from the ground, blocking paths and controlling space.

active_abilities.name: Decay Field
active_abilities.summary: Corrupts the ground in an area, dealing damage over time and weakening enemies' defenses.

active_abilities.name: Titan's Roar
active_abilities.summary: Unleashes a monumental roar that staggers enemies and slows their movement and attack speed.

passive.name: Hollow Endurance
passive.summary: Converts a portion of incoming damage into temporary armor (Endurance), bolstering Korvex's durability.
